name: daily-work-loop-copilot
description: Daily engineering loop with Task subagents, MCP command tools, Jira+Bitbucket or GitHub Issues+PRs, and status reports.

INTEGRATION_STACK.title: Integration stack
INTEGRATION_STACK.description: Primary MCP stack: atlassian (Jira + Bitbucket) or github (Issues + PRs).

JIRA_PROJECT_KEYS.title: Jira project keys
JIRA_PROJECT_KEYS.description: Comma-separated Jira project keys for queue and JQL (e.g. PROJ,ENG).

BITBUCKET_WORKSPACE.title: Bitbucket workspace
BITBUCKET_WORKSPACE.description: Bitbucket Cloud workspace slug for PR and pipeline queries.

BITBUCKET_REPO_SLUG.title: Default repo slug
BITBUCKET_REPO_SLUG.description: Optional default repository slug when the workspace has many repos.

STALE_REVIEW_DAYS.title: Stale review threshold (days)
STALE_REVIEW_DAYS.description: Warn when your review or owned PR attention exceeds this many days.

JIRA_KEY_PATTERN.title: Jira issue key regex
JIRA_KEY_PATTERN.description: Pattern to detect linked work in branches, commits, and PR titles.

ATLASSIAN_SITE_URL.title: Atlassian site URL
ATLASSIAN_SITE_URL.description: Optional. e.g. https://your-org.atlassian.net for links in queue output.

GITHUB_OWNER.title: GitHub owner
GITHUB_OWNER.description: Org or user slug when INTEGRATION_STACK=github.

GITHUB_ISSUE_LINK_PATTERN.title: GitHub issue link pattern
GITHUB_ISSUE_LINK_PATTERN.description: Optional regex; default matches #123 and Fixes #123 in commits/PRs.
